column1: # Approved exceptions to the PGF WatchTower branding gate (GA Priority 1 and 2).
# Read by the branding scanner (#106). A legacy name may appear ONLY where a row here
# allows it. Every row needs an owner and a reason, and says whether a customer can see it.
#   id    scanner regex (extended)    path regex (matched against the repo-relative path)    owner    customer_visible    reason
# The scanner fails on a row with an empty owner or reason, so this file cannot rot quietly.

column6: Go module path and import paths. Renaming forks us from upstream and breaks the rebase; never printed to users.
Server and agent environment variables. Shared contract with deployed agents and unit files; renaming needs a dual-read deprecation cycle.
Metric and label names (pmm_agent_id and similar). Stored in VictoriaMetrics and referenced by dashboards and alerts.
PostgreSQL database and role name. Stored in the database cluster; renaming needs ALTER DATABASE/ROLE on upgrade.
Grafana plugin IDs. Referenced by stored dashboard JSON and Grafana's loader.
supervisord program names. Keys into systemdUnitName(); renaming them yields pfw-pfw-*.service.
Exporter basic-auth username agreed between server and every running exporter. Agent-compat break if changed.
Attribution to the upstream project. Required by AGPL and accurate: this product is derived from percona/pmm.
Links to upstream reference for components shipped unmodified. Must stay labelled as upstream.
Generated code and dependency manifests. Fixed at their source, never edited by hand.
Release notes for the current build state the fork basis (PMM 3.9.0). Review again when the GA notes are written.
PENDING: Advisors check-definition service endpoint. Functional dependency, customer-visible in settings. Needs a replacement or removal decision before GA.
PENDING: functional upstream repo endpoint referenced by tooling. Remove with the install rewrite (#110) or justify.
The ORGANISATION, not the product: package signer, RPM Vendor, Maintainer, and /opt/postgres1st. Not 'Postgres1st WatchTower'.
Copyright headers in inherited source files. AGPL requires keeping them; they are comments, never printed.
Unit-test sources are not shipped. Tests that pin product text are updated with the code they test (#111).
Internal engineering records (identifier map, readiness notes) that name legacy strings in order to describe them. Not shipped in the bundle.
The guards themselves must spell the legacy names they search for.
Docs build tooling pulls the perconalab/pmm-doc-md image. Developer-only, never shipped; replace with a locally built image when the docs toolchain is revisited.
Copyright and licence notice for documentation inherited from Percona (Creative Commons). Legally required.
States that Percona is NOT our support channel and points to upstream docs. Attributed on purpose.
YAML comments in the docs site config that explain which upstream branding was removed. Not rendered. Nav titles and paths are NOT exempt.
Jinja {# #} comments in theme overrides that record what upstream branding was removed. Not rendered. Re-check if a rendered string is added here.
